items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Rockstar Games
items.claim: Rockstar lists November 19, 2026 and PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Take-Two Fiscal Q1 2027 results
items.claim: Take-Two reiterates the November 19, 2026 launch in its current fiscal outlook.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — PlayStation
items.claim: PlayStation lists November 19, 2026 for PS5/PS5 Pro and provides edition and preload details.

items.title: Buy Grand Theft Auto VI — Xbox
items.claim: Xbox lists November 19, 2026 for Xbox Series X|S and shows preorder editions.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Platforms, Editions, and Versions
items.claim: Rockstar Support lists PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, November 12 preload, and a code-in-box physical version.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look — Now Playing
items.claim: Rockstar released the extended look and describes it as in-game footage captured on PlayStation 5.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look Soars to No. 1
items.claim: Netflix reports 31.1 million views and No. 1 in 87 of 93 tracked countries; this is attention context, not readiness proof.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is Now Coming May 26, 2026
items.claim: Rockstar moved the target from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is Now Set to Launch November 19, 2026
items.claim: Rockstar moved the target from May 26, 2026 to November 19, 2026.

items.title: GTA 6 PC Release Could Come “Sooner” Than Expected
items.claim: VICE relays an unofficial VGC signal about a potentially shorter PC wait; no date or window is provided.

items.title: New GTA 6 leaked footage is actually years old, alleged leakers claim
items.claim: GamesRadar reports an unverified claim that some circulating clips are from 2023; no leaked material is reproduced.

items.title: Court grants Take-Two request in leak investigation
items.claim: Reported legal action shows an active infringement investigation but does not establish readiness or a date.

items.title: Rockstar responds to GTA 6 leaks
items.claim: Rockstar acknowledged the leak in a public response; the checked release materials still listed November 19, 2026.
